assumptions.name: Dataset: gdp_state_real_supply

assumptions.name: Dataset: hh_income_state
assumptions.value: state, year, income_median, income_mean (RM/month); rows missing either value dropped (years 1974-2024)

assumptions.name: Dataset: open-meteo air-quality (CAMS global)
assumptions.value: Daily mean PM2.5 (ug/m3) at each state capital (state_ref.csv), from hourly CAMS global model output; history only exists from Aug 2022 (years 2022-2026)
assumptions.source: Open-Meteo Air Quality API / Copernicus CAMS, CC BY 4.0; https://air-quality-api.open-meteo.com/v1/air-quality

assumptions.name: Reference year
assumptions.value: 2026 (ranked, not trained on; ranker trained on 2017-2025)

assumptions.name: 2026 data vintage
assumptions.value: Income, poverty, gini (HIES): carried+cpi; Unemployment (LFS): ytd; Hospital beds: carried; GDP per capita: carried; PM2.5 (yearly): ytd. Surveys are filled by build_features.py: linear between survey years, carried forward after the last one (income scaled by state CPI); 'ytd' = year to date

assumptions.name: PM2.5 exposure (training)
assumptions.value: Yearly mean daily PM2.5 at state capital; CAMS history starts Aug 2022, so 2023+ are observed and earlier years use the 2023+ mean (climatology); Selangor and KL share one CAMS grid cell
assumptions.source: Open-Meteo Air Quality API / Copernicus CAMS, CC BY 4.0

assumptions.name: PM2.5 by horizon (24/48/72 h)
assumptions.value: CAMS forecast at state capital, mean of each 24 h window ahead, issued 2026-10-17T23:00:00 (fetched); priority_by_horizon ranks each window, the allocation ranks the whole 0-72 h; stand-in until forecast.json from the physical model lands
assumptions.source: Open-Meteo Air Quality API / Copernicus CAMS, CC BY 4.0

assumptions.name: Priority label (PROXY)
assumptions.value: PROXY, not ground truth. harm = exposure x vulnerable people, graded by within-year quantile of harm (highest grade = most harm). Exposure = pm25_mean. Mean daily PM2.5 rather than unhealthy-day count: CAMS reads ~40 ug/m3 over the Klang Valley, just above the 35 ug/m3 threshold, so day counts there are inflated ~10-300x vs other states. 16 = one grade per state, i.e. the full within-year order of the harm proxy. With 4 (quartiles) the top four states tie, so the ranker never learns their order and barely reacts to the forecast.
assumptions.source: Team assumption: no official haze-priority list exists; poor households weighted 2x because exposure correlates with income (rho ~0.7)

assumptions.name: Vulnerable people weights
assumptions.value: {"pct_65plus": 1, "pct_under5": 1, "poverty_rate": 2}
assumptions.source: Team assumption: no official haze-priority list exists; poor households weighted 2x because exposure correlates with income (rho ~0.7)

assumptions.name: Baseline weights
assumptions.value: {"income_median": -0.4, "pct_65plus": 0.2, "pct_under5": 0.2, "beds_per_1000": -0.2}
assumptions.source: HazeGuard-MY brief: weighted index (low median income 0.4, 65+ 0.2, under-5 0.2, low beds 0.2) on within-year z-scores

assumptions.name: Ranker
assumptions.value: XGBRanker (objective=rank:pairwise, max_depth=2, n_estimators=100, learning_rate=0.1, random_state=42); leave-one-year-out over yearly + 3-day PM2.5 episode groups; gain = proxy grade (0-15), sklearn ndcg_score; NDCG@5 0.9834 vs baseline 0.6345

assumptions.name: Mobile clinic stock
assumptions.source: HazeGuard-MY brief default; placeholder, not real MOH stock

assumptions.name: N95 stock
assumptions.source: HazeGuard-MY brief default; placeholder, not real MOH stock

assumptions.name: Clinic rule
assumptions.value: one mobile clinic per state in priority order until clinics run out

assumptions.name: N95 rule
assumptions.value: states with priority <= 10 share the N95 stock in proportion to vulnerable people (label.vulnerable_weights), capped at 1 each; rounding leftovers go to the most urgent state first

assumptions.name: Actions
assumptions.value: priority <= 6: Deploy mobile clinic + distribute N95s; priority <= 10: Pre-position N95s, issue advisory; priority <= 16: Monitor

assumptions.name: Poverty line
assumptions.value: DOSM revised the poverty line in 2019, so 2016 rates (and 2017-2018, interpolated from them) use the old, lower line; features are z-scored within year so only the ordering of states is compared

assumptions.name: Putrajaya GDP
assumptions.value: Published separately only from 2023; earlier years back-filled at its 2023 GDP per head (KL's earlier figures include Putrajaya)

assumptions.name: State capital coordinates and area
assumptions.value: Hard-coded in data/resource_allocation/state_ref.csv
